```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(usmap)
```

---
## Reading the data
```{r}
shotspot <- read.csv("../data/shotspotter_dc_2006to2017.csv") %>%
  filter(year==2017) %>% mutate(exact_time = hour + (minute/60) + (second/3600))

nhl <- haven::read_dta("../data/NHL Master Dataset.dta") %>%
  filter(year==2018) %>%
  mutate(log_sal = log(Salary))

covid_2020 <- haven::read_dta("../data/covid_data.dta") %>%
  filter(year==2020 & month==12) %>%
  mutate(cases_per100k = cases/(population/1000),
         deaths_per100k = deaths/(population/1000))

abortion_distance <- haven::read_dta("../data/myers_clinic_distance_may24.dta") 
```

---
## Plots
```{r}
plot_usmap(data = covid_2020, values = "cases",  color = "midnightblue", labels=FALSE) + 
  scale_fill_continuous( low = "white", high = "midnightblue", 
                         name = "Total Cases", label = scales::comma) + 
  theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black"))
```
